record.body:
## Description

Prove the phase exit criteria: local dry-run of builder → aff verdict → aff attest → aff attest verify; templates and builder present with passing claim-widget verdict; strengthened CI pytest fails if build step or templates are removed.

## Approach

1. Run the builder and bin/aff verdict for claim-widget (integration through the real CLI).
2. Emit and verify an attestation with a throwaway ssh-ed25519 key and allowlist (local stand-in for Actions secrets).
3. Re-run the R4 pytest and the R1/R2 file checks.
4. Do not edit product code unless a verify failure shows a gap; then fix and re-check.
